//: Repository TOOLING dependencies only. This is NOT an application package.
The admin console arrives in a later phase under web/. Until then the only
reason Node exists in this repository is the tooling below, which has no
good equivalent in the other toolchains: commit-message linting, and
formatting for the YAML, JSON and Markdown that every language shares.
Keeping this at the root rather than inventing a tools/ package means an
engineer runs 'pnpm install' once and every cross-cutting check works.
name: callscreen-platform-tooling

//: Prettier config lives here rather than in a .prettierrc so that there is
one fewer root-level dotfile to explain during onboarding.
Markdown keeps its own line breaks. Reflowing prose produces diffs
that touch every line of a paragraph for a one-word change, which
Fail on a lockfile that does not match package.json rather than silently
re-resolving, matching the policy applied to uv.lock and go.sum.
